description: Preview the most recent US drilling permits for one state: at most 25 permits from the last 1 to 90 days, newest first, with the data's as-of date, age and the state's date coverage. Any API key can call it, including the Free plan. Use when the user wants a quick look at recent permits in a state, or when the account has no Well Permits subscription. Full history, multiple states and county or operator search need the subscription (opa_list_well_permits, opa_search_well_permits). Requires an API key.

state.description: US state name or 2-letter code (default: TX).

name: opa_preview_well_permits
title: Preview Well Permits
